characters.action: UNARMED precise palm: rear hand at waist and forward open palm gathers, short heel-of-palm push at chest height, elbow extends with shoulder turn, then arm recovers. Narrow efficient action, no exaggerated swing.

UNARMED low palm sweep: sink knees with palm close to lower ribs, lower palm sweeps outward across waist, torso follows and opposite hand balances, then return. Deliberately lower and broader than precise chest-height palm. No projectile artwork.

UNARMED raised palm snap: rear palm raised alongside shoulder, compact forward palm-heel snap, wrist turns inward in followthrough, then draw hand gently toward torso during recovery. No energy or motes baked into character.

UNARMED shield activation: two palms together close at chest, arms open in balanced circular movement, one palm forward while other stays near chest in ready stance, then relaxed return. No shield artwork baked into body; it is separate VFX.

UNARMED field activation: palms gather close near sternum, sink knees and press both palms down/outward at waist, arms open low evenly in disciplined balanced stance, then return to neutral. No weapons, swords, ground formation or particles in character source.

Straight-sword close-range combo: coiled sword ready near hip, rising diagonal sword cut, returning opposite diagonal cut with shoulder/cloth followthrough, controlled low sword recovery. No ranged energy or travel. Four genuine moving blade poses.

Straight-sword energy release: align sword near chest, precise forward thrust with straight arm, short elbow recoil while sword still forward, recover sword down. Feet remain planted; no dash. Energy projectile separate, no VFX in source.

Straight-sword formation activation: centered sword salute with blade raised, controlled blade tip lowering toward ground at feet, ready stance with sword angled low forward, recover to ordinary sword guard. No formation or spectral swords baked into body.

Straight-sword counter: low bent-knee readiness with sword held diagonally close to torso, smaller shoulder reaction receiving a hit with guard still present (not guaranteed blocking), compact retaliatory opposite diagonal slash, relaxed recovery. No invulnerability shield, dash, teleport or VFX. Readiness must visibly differ from ordinary idle.

Straight-sword ultimate preparation/release: centered vertical sword and free-hand two-finger preparation, controlled outward horizontal sword sweep, long directional arm extension followthrough, recovery to calm guard. Feet remain planted, no spinning360 or sword-riding. All energy waves separate.
